Commentary.Commentary: A good cameo from Mahmudullah helped Bangladesh to go past the 180-run mark. The visitors will back themselves as they defended 171 in the previous game. However, the hosts do have a power-house batting order. Promises to be an exciting finish to the finale. Join us on the other side of the break.

Carlos Brathwaite was the chief architect behind it as he outfoxed the batsmen with some shrewd changes in pace, picking up a couple of wickets in the process. Keemo Paul was also handy while Kesrick Williams bowled with good control. There was a passing shower but it didn't hamper the momentum of the visitors.

Bangladesh have posted a strong total on the board but they would have desired more taking into account the flier they got off to. It all started with Liton Das going bonkers from the word go. He played some eye-catchy strokes and scored a blazing fifty. The Windies pulled things back though as they picked up a few quick wickets in the middle overs.
Full ball in line of the stumps, Haque lots it to long off and they come back in time for the second. Bangladesh end on 184/5 after 20 overs.
Lovely! Excellent ball this! Takes all the pace off this one and lands it outside off. Haque goes for the slog but pulls out of it at the last moment. The keeper collects it on the bounce.
Slow ball outside off, Mahmudullah gets a top edge towards third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Well bowled and well played! Good cricket all round. Williams darts in a yorker on the legs of Mahmudullah. He just turns his bat to the leg side and the ball runs to the widish fine leg region.

No ball! It's all happening here. A no ball for overstepping. He serves this outside off, Haque swings and misses. The keeper cannot collect it properly and the batsmen take the bye. However, the umpire feels otherwise as he doesn't signal the bye. Might have been an edge there. Free Hit coming up.
Leg bye. Nice comeback. Fires this one into the pads of the batsman. Mahmudullah misses his shot and gets hit on the thigh pad.  They cross as the ball goes to the on side.
FOUR! Perfect start for the visitors. A boundary. Short ball from Williams, Mahmudullah pulls it over square leg to the ropes.
Fuller ball around off, Haque drills it in the gap through mid on for a brace. Still a very good over for the hosts. Just 6 off it.
The skipper using all his experience here. Darts another one full and outside off, Haque reaches for it but fails to get bat to ball.
Serves this full outside off, Haque lofts this over covers and will get two for it.
Wide! Not this time, skipper! Will have to bowl that again. Tries another one outside off, this time it is outside the tramline.
Gold dust this from the skipper! Another well bowled ball outside off, Haque can only make contact with thin air.
A swing and a miss! Full and outside off, Haque throws the kitchen sink at it but cannot make contact.
Slow ball outside off, Mahmudullah reaches for it and slices it to third man for one.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Full ball on middle and off and it is also slower in pace, Haque reads it well and lofts this over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Another two runs taken. Not in full balance trying to flat bat this. The ball comes off the top edge and goes over point. The batsmen take a couple of runs.
Good ball from Paul. Back of a length around off, Haque punches it back to him.
Smart from Haque. Plays this with soft hands through mid-wicket and has enough time to come back for the second.
Mahmudullah flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Poor ball and duly punished. Paul bowls this down the leg side. Mahmudullah just helps it on its way. It goes fine and runs to touch the fine leg fence.
Slower ball. Goes for the yorker but dishes out a fuller ball. Haque drives it to long on for a brace. Just five runs off the 17th.
Back of a length again, Haque can't get it past the bowler. Good over from Williams so far.
Back of a length ball and targets the hips of Ariful. The ball shoots up and hits Haque on the gloves as he wasn't expecting it.
We are back. Good to know that we haven't lost any overs. Ariful Haque to take strike as Kesrick Williams steams in to complete his over.
2135 local time update - Good news, folks! The rain has stopped. The groundsmen have done their work and we are ready to resume play anytime soon. Stay tuned for further updates.

2118 local time update - Well, the rain has picked up pace. The groundsmen rush in with the covers and the pitch has been covered. Let's hope it is a passing shower. Stay with us for further updates...

Short ball around off, Mahmudullah goes for the pull but is late to react and the ball hits him on the helmet. They cross and the ball is far from the fielder. Mahmudullah is fine and is good to continue.
Haque plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A bit of drizzle in the air.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ariful Haque is the next batsman. Meanwhile, Kesrick Williams is back for his final spell.

OUT! Gone! The slower ball has done the trick! Paul takes the pace off this one and lands it in line of the stumps. Shakib shuffles and looks to whip this over deep square leg. Cannot time it well enough and finds Nurse there. Big wicket for the hosts as Shakib towards the end can prove to be dangerous.

FOUR! Gets this away! Misses his yorker and dishes out a low full toss outside off. Shakib gets under it, his bottom hand comes off the handle but he still manages to loft it over mid-wicket to the fence.
Slow short ball, pulled to square leg for one.
Another pinpoint yorker. Aimed at the toes and Shakib gets his bat down in time. Takes a bottom edge and the ball goes to the leg side. Another run.
Leg bye! Good ball from Paul. Darts in a yorker down the leg side. Mahmudullah can't get bat to ball. The ball hits his leg and rolls to the on side as they change ends.
Wide! Cutter down the leg side, too far for Mahmudullah to make contact.
Full and outside off, Shakib drills it past covers for a run. Bangladesh will need these two to stay till the end.
Leg bye! Fullish delivery down the leg side, Shakib tries to flick it but is hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batsmen steal a run.
Keemo Paul to bowl his second over.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Wide! Brathwaite has been a bit wayward in this over. Bowls this one wide outside off, Mahmudullah doesn't bother with it.
Another short ball, pulled in front of square leg for a run.
Slower short ball in line of the stumps, Shakib pulls it nicely in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep moves to his right to make a stop. A couple taken.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, the Bangladesh skipper tries to flick it but misses.
A pinpoint yorker around off, Mahmudullah squeezes it past the point fielder to rotate strike.
Low full toss on off, Shakib turns it around the corner for a run.
Brathwaite comes back for a bowl.
SIX! You bet he can't! Suddenly Bangladesh get 11 off the over. Gets behind the ball and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a huge hit. Up go the arms of the umpire.
Quicker one around off, punched through covers for just a run. Just five runs so far, can he end it properly?
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Lofts this over the bowler's head to pick another run. Three singles off three balls now.
Loopy ball down the leg side, swept through square leg to rotate strike.
Full and around off, hit past mid on to give his partner the strike.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. A good one for the tourists. Russell bangs this short around middle and leg, Mahmudullah waits for it and pulls it through mid-wicket to the fence.
Another short ball down leg, Shakib pulls it to square leg for one.
Wide! Full and wide outside off, Shakib goes for the expansive drive but cannot get bat to ball. The umpire signals a wide.

Four! No, wait! That is a good effort from Williams at the boundary. Russell digs another ball short around off. Shakib goes for the pull and gets a top edge which flies towards the third man region. Kesrick dives to his right and stops a couple.
FOUR! Much-needed for the visitors. Drags his length back this time on middle and leg, Shakib pulls it with control to the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Pitches this one up around off, Shakib drives it from the middle but to the fielder at covers.
Back of a length ball on the legs, Shakib misses his flick and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Andre Russell is back on.

Loopy ball around off, Mahmudullah gets in position early and looks to paddle this one. Can't connect it properly and it falls short of the short fine leg fielder. A very good over from Nurse this. Just the three runs off it after being taken for 17 in his first over.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Just a single. A very good over so far from Nurse. Mahmudullah hits it past the mid on fielder to get another run.
A bit on the shorter side this time, Shakib cuts it through backward point to get off strike.
Another ball fired outside off, Shakib can't get it past that mid off region.
Quick and outside off, driven to mid off.
Ashley Nurse comes back for a bowl.
Length ball outside off, played to point.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Bangladesh suddenly losing steam after a great start. Beautifully executed from Kesrick and he gets the danger man, Liton Das. Bowls a slower one around off, Das uses his feet and looks to loft it over mid off but is beaten by the lack of pace. Ends up chipping it to Nurse stationed there. He knew it as soon as he hit it. Williams puts his name in his imaginary book and a blazing knock from Liton comes to an end.
On a back of a length once again on that leg side, Shakib flicks it away through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Wide! Will have to reload this one. Slower ball but serves it down the leg side. Shakib leaves it alone.
A slower full ball outside off, Das opens the bat face and hits it past point to get Bangladesh to the three-figure mark.
Length ball on the pads, Shakib flicks it away to deep square leg for a run.
Das plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out to bat. He played an innings of substance in the previous game. Can he replicate his effort?

OUT! Brathwaite strikes again, gets his second wicket to be precise! He has been the calm amidst the storm for the Windies. Bowls an identical delivery to the previous one but the only difference is that this one comes in substantially from a back of a length around off. There is some extra lift as well as Rahim tries to manufacture a dab to third man. However, he is cramped for room and only manages to glove it behind. Ramdin does the rest. The hosts need to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim tries to cut it away but gets a bottom edge. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Crisp! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Das leans ahead and drills it over covers for a rocketing boundary.

In the air... but safe! Low full toss from Brathwaite. Das kneels and shapes to play the paddle scoop but doesn't have much pace to work with. The ball lobs in the air towards short fine leg. Williams moves back and leaps but the ball goes over him. A run taken.
Brathwaite rolls his fingers on this one as Rahim comes down the track. He can only force it towards point for a quick single.
Brathwaite returns.
Pitched up ball outside off, eased through covers for a single.
FOUR! Innovative! Fullish ball in line of the stumps, Rahim moves inside the line and whips it away in front of square leg to pick up a boundary.
Fullish ball on middle and off, Das works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, cracked past the diving point fielder for a single.
Deft! Similar length ball outside off, Rahim dabs it past the keeper, much finer. The third man fielder moves to his left to cut it off. A couple taken.
On a length well outside off, Liton runs it down to third man for a single.
Kesrick Williams to bowl.
Back of a length ball on middle, Rahim defends it stoutly.

Maiden T20I fifty for Liton Das! It has been a whirlwind knock from him. Short ball on a flatter trajectory, Das punches it towards the bowler who is a bit late to react as the ball goes past him towards long off. A missed opportunity perhaps. A single taken. Das raises his bat towards the crowd and soaks in all the applause.
Drifting towards the pads, Das goes for the sweep but misses.
Tossed up ball, Rahim works it through the same region to rotate strike.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Slow through the air, Das tries to help it to the leg side but is hit on the pads.
Samuel Badree is back on.
Another short ball outside off, Rahim tries to do something fancy as he attempts to ramp it towards third man but misses.
Banged halfway down the track, Das plays a pull shot to fine leg for a single.
Slightly overpitched outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, played with an open bat face past backward point for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a length outside off, run down to third man for a single.
This one doesn't take off much as Rahim looks to play it with a horizontal bat but misses. Another successful over for Windies.
Well bowled! A bit of extra fizz on this one as the ball takes off from a length. Rahim pokes at it and is beaten.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! A gift! Shortish ball down the leg side, pulled away through backward square leg for a boundary.
Mushfiqur Rahim strides out to bat but will be at the other end as the batsmen cross.

OUT! Excellent presence of mind from Keemo Paul and he gets the reward as well! Wickets in quick succession for Windies, just what the doctor ordered for them. The mid on fielder was just pushed back behind and Paul bowls a ball according to the situation. Back of the hand slower one on a fullish length on off, encouraging Sarkar for an expansive shot. He falls prey to it and goes for a lofted shot but mistimes it towards long on. Powell stationed there is safe as houses. Almost an identical dismissal for him as the previous game, Paul gets the better of him twice.
Back of a length ball on off, answered from within the crease.
Keemo Paul is brought into the attack.
Slower ball on a length, tapped past point for a run. A wicket and 10 runs from the over.
FOUR! Brathwaite will be kicking himself. After a good delivery, he bowls a poor one. Low full toss on the pads, Sarkar just tickles it through short fine leg to get himself going.
Soumya Sarkar comes out to bat.

OUT! Absolutely against the run of play! The captain delivers when it was badly needed and he is pumped up. Iqbal pre-meditates as he shuffles across. Brathwaite smartly bowls a slower one on a length on middle and off. Iqbal kneels to play the paddle scoop but doesn't have enough pace to work it. Ends up playing it straight towards Williams at short fine leg who takes it easily. Iqbal who was the Man of the Match in the previous game walks off.
Full ball outside off, Das drives it past point for a run. We can see how animated Brathwaite is. He is egging his players to give their best.
FOUR! Exquisite! He is moving on like a train at the moment. Fuller in length outside off, Das comes ahead and strokes it through covers.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, driven crisply to mid on.
Carlos Brathwaite to have a bowl now.
FOUR! Shot! Iqbal gets into position expecting the short ball and pulls it over mid-wicket to find the fence. 19 from this over, change in pace hasn't worked for the Windies.
A dot ball from Russell! Short ball, rising on Iqbal. He fends it off awkwardly.

FOUR! Stand and deliver! That was hammered. Slightly overpitched on off, Tamim punches it hard down the ground to pick up another boundary. 50 up for Bangladesh and it has come at the rate of knots. Actually, it is their quickest in T20Is.
Das comes down the track and Russell smartly bowls a slower one. It is helped through mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! Fortune favours the brave! They feel that they can pull off anything at the moment. Short ball on middle, Das goes for the pull but gets a big top edge over the keeper. It is going, going and sails over the fence.
FOUR! No, he can't as of now! A poor delivery and duly punished! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Das comes inside the line and swipes it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Andre Russell comes into the attack. Can he dry up the runs?

SIX! Boom! Iqbal is continuing from where he left off in the last game. In the slot for Tamim. He kneels and slog sweeps it with aplomb over mid-wicket to hit a towering maximum. 12 from this over, 29 from the last two. The Windies spinners have been put on immense pressure in the Powerplay.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Iqbal flat-bats it back towards the bowler.
Once again Tamim frees his arms and nails the drive but finds the point fielder.
FOUR! All grace and timing written on that stroke! Half-volley outside off, Iqbal's eyes light up as he leans ahead and drills it through covers to pick up his first boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Fullish delivery, knocked down to long off for a single.

FOUR! 17 from the over! Das is on a roll. Tossed up ball outside off, Liton slog sweeps it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left but it goes past him in a flash for a rocketing boundary.

SIX! You need this kind of momentum at the beginning of the innings. Typical response from the bowler as he bowls this one on a shorter length. Das lines it up, shuffles across and pulls it over backward square leg to pick up back-to-back maximums.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Loopy delivery on a fullish length outside off, Das crouches and slog sweeps it over cow corner to clear the fence. Nice aggressive start from him.
Slower through the air outside off, Iqbal eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Another delivery which comes in with the angle, Tamim defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Nurse starts off with an arm ball. Iqbal leans ahead tentatively and blocks it.
Spin from both ends. Ashley Nurse to share the new ball from the other end.
Well played! Short ball, pulled away towards cow corner for a couple. 8 from the first over, decent start for Bangladesh.
Quicker and straighter one, skids after pitching. Das hangs back and dead-bats it.
Badree bowls his stock delivery. A quick leg spinner on off and gets it to spin in. Iqbal works it nicely towards mid-wicket for a run and gets off the mark.
On a flatter trajectory and shorter in length, Das half-pulls it through wide mid on to rotate strike.
Liton comes down the track but he is not quite to the pitch of this one. Ends up defending it eventually.
FOUR! Dream start for Bangladesh! Low full toss down the leg side, Das kneels and sweeps it away through square leg to find the fence.
We are all set to get rolling. Liton Das and Tamim Iqbal to open the batting for Bangladesh. Samuel Badree has the new ball in his hand. Here we go...

Windies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite says that he feels that toss is not a factor. Adds that they want to restrict Bangladesh to as less as possible and come out on top. Mentions that they have had a few individual chats. Announces that Andre Russell is fit and raring to go. Informs that there is one change - Evin Lewis misses out and Chadwick Walton makes the cut in his place.

Bangladesh skipper, Shakib Al Hasan says that they will bat first. States that it looks like a good wicket but it might get slower as back-to-back games are being played on it. Informs that they are playing with the same team.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to bat.

Pitch Report - Jeff Dujon assessing the surface says that there is a bit of sheen on the surface and it will play the same way it played in the previous game. States that the ball will come onto the bat and it will be conducive for strokeplay.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final T20I. Just like the Windies fought back in the ODI series, Bangladesh have bounced back with aplomb in the shortest format of the game. We all saw in the previous game how formidable a unit they are when they fire on all cylinders. Shakib Al Hasan will want his men to turn up once again. Windies, on the other hand, are a dangerous team too and you can take them lightly at your own peril. With the series on the line, expect every player to turn up the heat. Toss and team news coming up in a while...
